* [[Titan Armor]]

== Notes ==
* Shares his spawn point with [[Tortitudo Probo]], [[Valetudo Rubor]], [[Moles Quibus]], and [[Scelus Prosum]].
* All five bosses spawn at the four locations shown.  The two western locations are really one large area with three bosses.  The other two spawn points have a single boss each.
* At the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.

== Trivia ==
* 'Maligo Libens' can be translated from Latin as "I do evil willingly".
